HomePage.introTitle: Bona Dipolelo le Diporofaele tsa Instagram tsa Phatlalatso ka go sa Itsiwe
HomePage.introText1: InstaView Stories ke Sebonelo sa Dipolelo tsa Instagram se se mahala se se go thusang go batlisisa diteng tsa Instagram tse di leng teng kwa ntle ga go tsena. Tsenya leina la mosebedisi la Instagram kgotsa kgokagano ya porofaele go bona Dipolelo tse di leng teng, go batlisisa dintlha tsa porofaele, le go batlisisa ditshwantsho, divhidio, Di-Reels le Di-Highlights tsa Dipolelo tsa Instagram.
HomePage.introText2: O ka bo o dirisa InstaView Stories go bona diposo, go bona ditshwantsho tsa porofaele, le go fitlhelela diteng tse di rileng ka go tsenya kgokagano ya poso kgotsa Reel ya Instagram e e tshegetsweng mme wa ntsha ka tobetso e le nngwe mo setirisweng sengwe le sengwe. Sedirisi se se diretswe go batlisisa ka bonolo le ka phuthologo, go se tlhokege kwadiso, lefoko la sephiri la Instagram, kgotsa dintlha tsa botho.
HomePage.introText3: Le fa o batla go bona Dipolelo tsa Instagram ka go sa itsiwe, go batlisisa porofaele ya modirisi, go batlisisa Di-Highlights tsa Instagram, kgotsa go bona setshwantsho, vhidio, kgotsa Reel e e rileng, InstaView Stories e kopanya ditshiamelo tse mo Sebonelong se le sengwe sa Porofaele le Dipolelo tsa Instagram se se motlhofo go se dirisa.
HomePage.featuresTitle: Ditshiamelo tsa Sebonelo sa Dipolelo tsa Instagram
HomePage.featuresIntro: Batlisisa diteng tsa Instagram tse di phatlaladitsweng ka InstaView Stories. Bona Dipolelo, diporofaele, diposo, Di-Highlights, ditshwantsho, divhidio le Di-Reels tsa phatlalatso ka sedirisi se le sengwe se se phepa le se se motlhofo go se dirisa.
HomePage.featureCard1Text: Tsenya leina la mosebedisi la Instagram la phatlalatso kgotsa kgokagano ya porofaele go batlisisa Dipolelo tsa Instagram tse di leng teng. Sebonelo sa rona sa Dipolelo sa Instagram se se mahala se dira gore go nne bonolo go fitlhela diteng tsa Dipolelo tsa phatlalatso kwa ntle ga go tsena.
HomePage.featureCard2Text: Bona dintlha tse di leng teng tsa porofaele ya phatlalatso, go akaretsa tlhaloso ka bokhutshwane, balatedi, ba o ba latelang, diposo, le dintlha tsa go netefadiwa. Dirisa InstaView Stories jaaka Sebonelo se se motlhofo sa Diporofaele tsa Instagram go batlisisa diakhaonto tsa phatlalatso mo lefelong le le lengwe.
HomePage.featureCard3Text: Batlisisa ditshwantsho le divhidio tse di abelanweng ke diporofaele tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso. Batlisisa diposo tsa Instagram tse di leng teng ka sebopego se se phepa le se se motlhofo, kwa ntle ga go tsamaya mo popegong e e raraaneng.
HomePage.featureCard4Text: Batlisisa Di-Highlights tsa Dipolelo tsa Instagram tse di leng teng go tswa mo diporofaeleng tsa phatlalatso. Sebonelo sa rona sa Di-Highlights tsa Instagram se go thusa go fitlhela Dipolelo tse di bolokilweng le go batlisisa diteng tsa Di-Highlights tsa phatlalatso mo lefelong le le lengwe.
HomePage.featureCard5Text: Boloka ditshwantsho le divhidio tsa Dipolelo tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng fa tlhopho ya go ntsha e tshegediwa. Setshollo sa Dipolelo tsa Instagram se naya tsela e e siameng ya go fitlhelela diteng tsa Dipolelo tse di tshegediwang.
HomePage.featureCard6Text: Ntsha Di-Highlights tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng fa di tshegediwa. Dirisa Setshollo sa Di-Highlights tsa Instagram go boloka ditshwantsho le divhidio tsa Di-Highlights tse di tshegediwang gore o di bone moragonyana.
HomePage.featureCard7Text: Bona le go boloka ditshwantsho tse di leng teng go tswa mo diposong tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso. Setshollo sa rona sa Ditshwantsho tsa Instagram se naya tlhopho e e motlhofo ya go ntsha diteng tsa ditshwantsho tsa phatlalatso tse di tshegediwang.
HomePage.featureCard8Text: Fitlhelela divhidio tse di leng teng go tswa mo diposong le diporofaeleng tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso. Ntsha divhidio tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di tshegediwang ka tsela e e motlhofo le e e siameng.
HomePage.featureCard9Text: Batlisisa le go ntsha Di-Reels tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng fa di tshegediwa. Setshollo sa Di-Reels tsa Instagram se dira gore go nne bonolo go fitlhelela divhidio tsa Reel tse di tshegediwang go tswa mo diporofaeleng tsa phatlalatso kgotsa dikgokaganong tse di tlhamaletseng tsa poso.
HomePage.featureCard10Title: Setshollo sa Ditshwantsho tsa Porofaele tsa Instagram
HomePage.featureCard10Text: Bona ditshwantsho tsa porofaele tse di leng teng go tswa mo diakhaontong tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso mme o di ntshe fa di tshegediwa. Setshollo sa Ditshwantsho tsa Porofaele tsa Instagram se naya tsela e e motlhofo ya go fitlhelela ditshwantsho tsa porofaele tsa phatlalatso.
HomePage.featuresClosing: Ditshiamelo tsotlhe di bereka fela le diteng tsa Instagram tse di leng teng. Ga go tlhokege go tsena mo Instagram, kwadiso, lefoko la sephiri, kgotsa dintlha tsa botho.
HomePage.howItWorksTitle: Kafa InstaView Stories e Berekang ka Teng
HomePage.howItWorksIntro: Batlisisa Dipolelo, diporofaele, diposo, Di-Highlights, ditshwantsho, divhidio le Di-Reels tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso ka dikgato tse tharo tse di motlhofo.
HomePage.step1Title: Tsenya Leina la Mosebedisi kgotsa Kgokagano
HomePage.step1Text: Tsenya leina la mosebedisi la Instagram la phatlalatso, kgokagano ya porofaele, kgotsa URL ya poso kgotsa Reel ya Instagram e e tshegetsweng mo lomating lwa go batla.
HomePage.step2Title: Batlisisa Diteng tsa Instagram tsa Phatlalatso
HomePage.step2Text: Tobetsa Bona Dipolelo go fitlhelela Dipolelo tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng, dintlha tsa porofaele, diposo, ditshwantsho, divhidio, Di-Reels le Di-Highlights tsa Dipolelo tsa Instagram.
HomePage.step3Text: Tlhopha diteng tse o batlang go di batlisisa. Fa go tshegediwa, o ka ntsha Dipolelo, Di-Highlights, ditshwantsho, divhidio, Di-Reels le ditshwantsho tsa porofaele tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng.
HomePage.howItWorksCta: Simolola go batlisisa diteng tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso ka InstaView Stories—ga go tlhokege kwadiso kgotsa go tsena mo Instagram.
HomePage.whyTitle: Ke ka Eng o Tlhopha InstaView Stories?
HomePage.whyText: InstaView Stories e naya tsela e e motlhofo le e e siameng ya go batlisisa diteng tsa Instagram tse di phatlaladitsweng kwa ntle ga dikgato tse di sa tlhokegeng.
HomePage.whyItem1Title: Ga go Tlhokege go Tsena mo Instagram
HomePage.whyItem1Text: Batlisisa Dipolelo, diporofaele, diposo le Di-Reels tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso kwa ntle ga go tsenya leina la gago la mosebedisi, lefoko la sephiri, kgotsa dintlha tsa go tsena tsa Instagram.
HomePage.whyItem2Title: Go Bona ka go sa Itsiwe
HomePage.whyItem2Text: Bona diteng tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng jaaka (Dipolelo, Di-Highlights, ditshwantsho, divhidio, Di-Reels, dintlha tsa porofaele, le ditshwantsho tsa porofaele) kwa ntle ga go dirisana le porofaele ka tlhamalalo. Ke diteng tsa phatlalatso fela tse di tshegediwang.
HomePage.whyItem3Title: Go Bofefo le go Motlhofo go Dirisa
HomePage.whyItem3Text: Tsenya leina la mosebedisi kgotsa kgokagano ya Instagram e e tshegetsweng mme o fitlhelele diteng tse di leng teng ka sebopego se se motlhofo le se se sa raraanang.
HomePage.whyItem4Text: Dirisa InstaView Stories mo diselefounung tse di botlhale, dithaebole, dikhomputara tse di rwalwang le tse di sa rwalweng kwa ntle ga go tsenya software e nngwe.
HomePage.whyItem5Text: Batlisisa Dipolelo, Di-Highlights, ditshwantsho, divhidio, Di-Reels, dintlha tsa porofaele le ditshwantsho tsa porofaele tsa phatlalatso ka sedirisi se le sengwe.
HomePage.whyItem6Title: Ditlhopho tsa go Ntsha tse di Tshegediwang
HomePage.whyItem6Text: Ntsha Dipolelo, Di-Highlights, ditshwantsho, divhidio, Di-Reels le ditshwantsho tsa porofaele tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng fa ditshiamelo tsa go ntsha di tshegediwa.
HomePage.whyItem7Title: Fitlhelela go tswa Gongwe le Gongwe
HomePage.whyItem7Text: Dirisa InstaView Stories go tswa gongwe le gongwe fa go na le kgokagano ya inthanete. Sedirisi se diretswe badirisi ba ba batlisisang diteng tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso mo lefatsheng lotlhe.
HomePage.whyItem8Text: Ga go tlhokege lefoko la sephiri la Instagram, kwadiso ya akhaonto, kgotsa dintlha tsa botho tse di sa tlhokegeng go dirisa sedirisi se.
HomePage.whyItem9Text: Ipelele go bona diteng tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso kwa ntle ga selekanyo, kwa ntle ga dipatiso, ditlhwatlhwa, kgotsa ditshenyegelo tse di fitlhilweng.
HomePage.whyNote: InstaView Stories e tshegetsa diteng tsa Instagram tse di phatlaladitsweng fela. Diakhaonto tsa sephiri le diteng tse di thibetsweng ga di kake tsa fitlhelelwa.
HomePage.doItem1: Go ntsha tsebe ya porofaele ya phatlalatso ka tsela e e tshwanang le e sebatlisisi sengwe le sengwe se se sa itsiweng se ka e ntshang ka teng
HomePage.doItem2: Go bontsha dintlha tse Instagram e di beileng mo tsebeng eo tse e di dirileng tsa phatlalatso
HomePage.doItem3: Ga go na sepe se sengwe: ga go na go batlisisa feiti, go romela melaetsa, kgotsa go laola akhaonto
HomePage.dontItem1: Ga re ke re botsa lefoko la gago la sephiri la Instagram kgotsa dintlha tsa go tsena
HomePage.dontItem2: Ga re ke re fitlhelele diakhaonto tsa sephiri kgotsa go feta dipeelo tsa sephiri
HomePage.dontItem3: Ga re ke re tlhoke akhaonto go dirisa sedirisi se

HomePage.contactText: Dipotso, maikutlo, kgotsa kopo e e amanang le diteng tse di bontshitsweng phatlalatsa: re ikgolaganye mme re tla go araba.
HomePage.faqIntro: Dikarabo tsa dipotso tse di tlwaelegileng ka go bona le go ntsha Dipolelo, diporofaele, diposo, Di-Highlights le Di-Reels tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso ka InstaView Stories.
HomePage.faq1A: InstaView Stories ke Sebonelo sa Dipolelo tsa Instagram sa inthanete se se go letlang go batlisisa Dipolelo, diporofaele, diposo, Di-Highlights, ditshwantsho, divhidio le Di-Reels tsa Instagram tse di phatlaladitsweng ka sedirisi se le sengwe se se motlhofo.
HomePage.faq2Q: A nka bona Dipolelo tsa Instagram kwa ntle ga go tsena?
HomePage.faq2A: Ee. O ka batlisisa Dipolelo tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng kwa ntle ga go tsena mo Instagram kgotsa go naya lefoko la gago la sephiri la Instagram.
HomePage.faq3Q: A nka bona Dipolelo tsa Instagram ka go sa itsiwe?
HomePage.faq3A: O ka bona Dipolelo tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng kwa ntle ga go dirisana le porofaele ya Instagram ka tlhamalalo. InstaView Stories ga e tshegetse diteng tsa sephiri kgotsa tse di thibetsweng.
HomePage.faq4Q: A InstaView Stories e mahala go e dirisa?
HomePage.faq4A: Ee. InstaView Stories e diretswe go naya phitlhelelo ya mahala mo diteng tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di tshegediwang. Ditshiamelo dingwe di ka ikaega ka go nna teng ga diteng le tshegetso ya thekniki.
HomePage.faq5Q: A nka bona diakhaonto tsa Instagram tsa sephiri?
HomePage.faq5A: Nnyaa. InstaView Stories e tshegetsa fela diteng tsa Instagram tse di phatlaladitsweng. Diakhaonto tsa sephiri le Dipolelo tse di thibetsweng ga di kake tsa fitlhelelwa.
HomePage.faq6Q: A nka dirisa kgokagano ya porofaele ya Instagram?
HomePage.faq6A: Ee. O ka tsenya leina la mosebedisi la Instagram la phatlalatso kgotsa kgokagano ya porofaele go batlisisa Dipolelo tse di leng teng, dintlha tsa porofaele, diposo le Di-Highlights.
HomePage.faq7Q: A nka bona Di-Highlights tsa Instagram?
HomePage.faq7A: Ee. O ka batlisisa Di-Highlights tsa Dipolelo tsa Instagram tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng o dirisa Sebonelo sa Di-Highlights tsa Instagram. Go ntsha Di-Highlights go teng fela fa go tshegediwa.
HomePage.faq8Q: A nka ntsha Dipolelo le Di-Reels tsa Instagram?
HomePage.faq8A: O ka ntsha Dipolelo, ditshwantsho, divhidio, Di-Highlights le Di-Reels tsa phatlalatso tse di leng teng fa tlhopho ya go ntsha e tshegediwa mo diteng tseo.
HomePage.faq9Q: A ke tlhoka akhaonto ya Instagram?
HomePage.faq9A: Nnyaa. Ga o tlhoke akhaonto ya Instagram, kwadiso, kgotsa go tsena mo Instagram go dirisa InstaView Stories.
HomePage.faq10Q: A InstaView Stories e teng mo diselefounung?
HomePage.faq10A: Ee. InstaView Stories e ka dirisiwa mo diselefounung tse di botlhale, dithaebole, dikhomputara tse di rwalwang le tse di sa rwalweng ka sebatlisisi sa webo.
HomePage.faq11Q: Ke eng fa diteng dingwe tsa Instagram di sa fitlhelelesege?
HomePage.faq11A: Diteng di ka tswa di sa fitlhelelesege ka gonne porofaele ke ya sephiri, Polelo e feditse nako, diteng di tlositswe, kgotsa phitlhelelo ya Instagram e thibetswe ka thekniki.
HomePage.faq12Q: A lefoko la me la sephiri la Instagram le a tlhokega?
HomePage.faq12A: Nnyaa. O se ka wa tsenya lefoko la gago la sephiri la Instagram mo InstaView Stories. Sedirisi se ga se tlhoke dintlha tsa gago tsa go tsena mo Instagram kgotsa dintlha tsa botho tse di sa tlhokegeng.

TermsPage.copyrightText2: Diteng tsa Instagram, go akaretsa ditshwantsho, divhidio, dipolelo, di-reels, ditshwantsho tsa porofaele, dilogo, le didirisiwa tse dingwe, di ka sireletsegile ka ditshwanelo tsa tlhamo, matshwao a kgwebo, kgotsa ditshwanelo tse dingwe tsa thepa ya tlhaloganyo.
TermsPage.copyrightText3: Badirisi ba ikarabela go bona tetla dipe tse di tlhokegang pele ba dirisa diteng tsa ba boraro kwa ntle ga maikaelelo a botho kgotsa a mangwe a a dumelesegang ka fa molaong.
TermsPage.copyrightText4: Fa o dumela gore diteng tse di fitlhelelwang ka webosaete ya rona di tlola ditshwanelo tsa gago, tsweetswee re ikgolaganye ka dintlha tse di amanang gore re sekaseke kgang ya gago.
TermsPage.thirdPartyPlatformText1: InstaView Stories ke webosaete e e ikemetseng ebile ga e amane, ga e tshegediwe, ga e thusiwe ka madi, ebile ga e golaganngwe ka tsela e e semmuso le Instagram kgotsa Meta Platforms, Inc., ntle le fa go boletswe ka tsela e sele ka tlhamalalo.
TermsPage.thirdPartyPlatformText2: Instagram le matshwao a kgwebo a a amanang natso ke a beng ba one ka bo bone.
TermsPage.thirdPartyPlatformText3: Webosaete ya rona e ka dirisana le kgotsa e supa diteng tse di phatlaladitsweng tse di tswang mo disistimung tsa ba boraro. Ga re laole go nna teng, tshwanelo ya nnete, kgotsa go tswelela go nna teng ga diteng tsa ba boraro.
TermsPage.contentAvailabilityText1: Ga re netefatse gore Polelo, poso, Reel, Highlight, setshwantsho, vhidio, kgotsa porofaele nngwe le nngwe ya Instagram ya phatlalatso e tla nna e le teng ka tirelo ya rona.
TermsPage.contentAvailabilityText2: Diteng di ka se nne teng ka ntlha ya go:
TermsPage.contentAvailabilityItem6: Se ke ya fitlhelesega ka ntlha ya thekniki
TermsPage.contentAvailabilityText3: Go nna teng ga tshiamelo epe kgotsa diteng le gona go ka fetoga kwa ntle ga kitsiso.
TermsPage.accuracyText1: Re ikaeletse go naya dintlha tse di mosola le tse di nepagetseng, mme ga re netefatse gore dintlha tsotlhe tsa porofaele, dintlha tsa diteng, kgotsa dintlha tse dingwe tse di bontshiwang ka webosaete di tla nna di feletse, tsa jaanong, kgotsa kwa ntle ga diphoso.
TermsPage.accuracyText2: Dintlha tse di tswang mo disistimung tsa ba boraro di ka fetoga ka boithati go sa kgatlhanngwe le InstaView Stories.
TermsPage.serviceAvailabilityText1: Re dira maiteko a a utlwalang go boloka InstaView Stories e le teng le e dira sentle. Le fa go ntse jalo, ga re netefatse phitlhelelo e e sa kgaoganeng, e e sireletsegileng, kgotsa e e kwa ntle ga diphoso.
TermsPage.serviceAvailabilityText2: Webosaete kgotsa ditshiamelo tse dingwe di ka se nne teng ka dinako tse dingwe ka ntlha ya tlhokomelo, mathata a thekniki, ditokafatso, mathata a lefapha la inthanete, kgotsa maemo a a fetang taolo ya rona.
TermsPage.warrantiesText1: InstaView Stories e newa go ya ka fa e leng "teng" ka gona.
TermsPage.warrantiesText2: Go ya ka fa molao o o dirisiwang o dumelelang ka gona, ga re dire ditiisetso malebana le go tlala, tshwanelo ya nnete, go ikanyega, go nna teng, kgotsa go tshwanela ga webosaete kgotsa ditirelo tsa yona ka maikaelelo mangwe le mangwe a a rileng.
TermsPage.liabilityText1: Go ya kafa molao o o dirisiwang o dumelelang ka gona, InstaView Stories le batsamaisi ba yona ga ba na go ikarabela ditahlego, matshenyo, kgotsa ditatofatso tse di tlhagang ka ntlha ya tiriso ya gago, kgotsa go se kgone go dirisa, webosaete kgotsa diteng tsa ba boraro tse di fitlhelelwang ka yona.
TermsPage.liabilityText2: O ikarabela kafa o dirisang webosaete ka gona le diteng dipe tse di boneng ka tirelo eno.
TermsPage.privacyText: Tiriso ya gago ya InstaView Stories le yona e laolwa ke <privacyLink>Pholisi ya Sephiri</privacyLink> ya rona, e e tlhalosang kafa dintlha di ka tsamaisiwang ka gona fa o dirisa webosaete ya rona.
TermsPage.changesText1: Re ka ntlafatsa Melawana le Dipeelano eno ka dinako tse di rileng go bontsha diphetogo mo ditirelong, webosaete, kgotsa ditlhokegong tse di dirisiwang.
TermsPage.changesText2: Melawana e e ntlafaditsweng e tla phatlalatswa mo tsebeng eno le letlha le le ntlafaditsweng la go Ntlafaditswe la Bofelo. Go tswelela ga gago go dirisa webosaete morago ga diphetogo go kaya gore o dumetse melawana e e ntlafaditsweng.
TermsPage.contactIntro: Fa o na le dipotso ka Melawana le Dipeelano eno, tsweetswee re ikgolaganye:
TermsPage.contactVisit: O ka gape wa etela <contactLink>tsebe ya go Ikgolaganya le Rona</contactLink> ya rona.
TermsPage.contactMore: Go dintlha tse dingwe, o ka bala <aboutLink>Ka ga Rona</aboutLink> le <disclaimerLink>Kganetso</disclaimerLink> ya rona.
